title: Bedrock — Customer & Feature Usage — prod
description: Per-customer / per-feature token usage and cost. Sourced from the Bedrock invocation log (Converse calls) and ai.call structured log lines (KB Retrieve, Comprehend Medical, PhysioAssistant agent).

panels.title: Top customers by Bedrock token usage

targets.expression: filter requestMetadata.env = "prod" and ispresent(requestMetadata.company_uid) | stats sum(input.inputTokenCount) as input_tokens, sum(output.outputTokenCount) as output_tokens, count() as calls by requestMetadata.company_uid | sort calls desc | limit 20

filter requestMetadata.env = "prod" and ispresent(requestMetadata.feature) | stats sum(input.inputTokenCount) as input_tokens, sum(output.outputTokenCount) as output_tokens, count() as calls by requestMetadata.feature, modelId | sort calls desc
filter requestMetadata.env = "prod" and ispresent(requestMetadata.feature) | stats sum(input.inputTokenCount + output.outputTokenCount) as total_tokens by bin(5m), requestMetadata.feature

panels.title: Company × user × feature × model — token breakdown

targets.expression: filter requestMetadata.env = "prod" and ispresent(requestMetadata.company_uid) and ispresent(requestMetadata.feature) | stats sum(input.inputTokenCount) as input_tokens, sum(output.outputTokenCount) as output_tokens, count() as calls by requestMetadata.company_uid, requestMetadata.user_id, requestMetadata.feature, modelId | sort calls desc | limit 200

panels.title: Non-Bedrock surfaces (KB Retrieve, Comprehend, Agent) — ai.call
ai.call by feature (KB Retrieve, Comprehend, Agent)

targets.expression: filter @message like /"marker":"ai\.call"/ | parse @message /"feature":"(?<feature>[^"]+)"/ | parse @message /"operation":"(?<operation>[^"]+)"/ | parse @message /"company_uid":"(?<company_uid>[^"]+)"/ | parse @message /"user_id":"(?<user_id>[^"]+)"/ | parse @message /"status":"(?<status>[^"]+)"/ | parse @message /"latency_ms":(?<latency_ms>\d+)/ | stats count() as calls, avg(latency_ms) as avg_ms, pct(latency_ms, 95) as p95_ms by feature, status | sort calls desc

filter @message like /"marker":"ai\.call"/ | parse @message /"feature":"(?<feature>[^"]+)"/ | parse @message /"operation":"(?<operation>[^"]+)"/ | parse @message /"company_uid":"(?<company_uid>[^"]+)"/ | parse @message /"user_id":"(?<user_id>[^"]+)"/ | parse @message /"status":"(?<status>[^"]+)"/ | parse @message /"latency_ms":(?<latency_ms>\d+)/ | filter ispresent(company_uid) | stats count() as calls, avg(latency_ms) as avg_ms by company_uid, user_id, feature | sort calls desc | limit 100

panels.title: Chat turns — outer InvokeAgent (one row per chat message)

targets.expression: filter @message like /"marker":"ai\.call"/ | parse @message /"feature":"(?<feature>[^"]+)"/ | parse @message /"operation":"(?<operation>[^"]+)"/ | parse @message /"company_uid":"(?<company_uid>[^"]+)"/ | parse @message /"user_id":"(?<user_id>[^"]+)"/ | parse @message /"status":"(?<status>[^"]+)"/ | parse @message /"latency_ms":(?<latency_ms>\d+)/ | parse @message /"session_id":"(?<session_id>[^"]+)"/ | parse @message /"trace_events":(?<trace_events>\d+)/ | parse @message /"response_chars":(?<response_chars>\d+)/ | filter feature = "physio_chat" and operation = "InvokeAgent" | stats count() as chats, avg(latency_ms) as avg_ms, pct(latency_ms, 95) as p95_ms, sum(trace_events) as total_trace_events, avg(response_chars) as avg_chars by company_uid, user_id | sort chats desc
